_comment: Curated explainer map for common Drupal 9/10 -> 11 deprecations, consumed by scripts/analysis/explain-deprecations.sh. Each entry: 'pattern' is a case-insensitive ERE matched against a deprecation/Rector line; 'symbol' keys a deterministic drupal.org change-records SEARCH url (we NEVER hardcode a change-record node id, so the link is always correct); 'category' groups the symbol into a D9/10 -> 11 migration area for the didactic port report (entries without one fall back to 'other'); 'why' is the one-line human explanation; 'fix' is the modern replacement. Add entries freely — this is a best-effort teaching aid, not an exhaustive list.

deprecations.why: Global message helper removed.
deprecations.fix: Inject and use the 'messenger' service ($this->messenger()->addStatus(...)).

deprecations.why: \Drupal::url() removed.
deprecations.fix: Use Url::fromRoute()/fromUri() and the 'url_generator' service.

deprecations.why: format_date() removed.
deprecations.fix: Inject the 'date.formatter' service and call ->format().

deprecations.why: Procedural entity loaders removed.
deprecations.fix: Use the 'entity_type.manager' service: ->getStorage('node')->load($id).

deprecations.why: EntityManager split up.
deprecations.fix: Use EntityTypeManagerInterface (and the dedicated repository/field managers).

deprecations.why: Procedural database API removed.
deprecations.fix: Inject the 'database' connection service and use its query builders.

deprecations.why: REQUEST_TIME constant removed.
deprecations.fix: Inject the 'datetime.time' service: ->getRequestTime().

deprecations.why: Static \Drupal:: service access is discouraged (and brittle to test).
deprecations.fix: Constructor-inject the service via create()/ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (Phase 2).

deprecations.why: Twig {% spaceless %} removed in Twig 3.
deprecations.fix: Use the 'spaceless' filter via {% apply spaceless %} ... {% endapply %}, or explicit whitespace control.

deprecations.why: jQuery UI libraries removed from core.
deprecations.fix: Replace with a native/JS alternative or the contrib jquery_ui_* shims; re-evaluate the UI in Phase 2.

deprecations.why: CKEditor 4 removed; CKEditor 5 is the only core editor.
deprecations.fix: Migrate the editor config/plugins to CKEditor 5 (often non-mechanical — consider Phase 2).

deprecations.why: Some assertion helpers changed.
deprecations.fix: Use native assert() with class type-hints, or proper type declarations.

deprecations.why: Legacy PHPUnit mock APIs removed in PHPUnit 10/11.
deprecations.fix: Use createMock()/createStub() and the modern matcher API; remove at().

deprecations.why: Forms/controllers should inject services, not call \Drupal:: statically.
deprecations.fix: Implement create() and inject the services you need.

deprecations.why: A class with create() must implement ContainerFactoryPluginInterface (plugins) or ContainerInjectionInterface (forms/controllers); QueueWorkerBase, BlockBase, FilterBase, ActionBase and core PluginBase do not provide it.
deprecations.fix: Keep/restore 'implements ContainerFactoryPluginInterface' and its use statement (check-port-safety.sh).

deprecations.why: new self() in create() of a non-final class hands subclasses a parent instance.
deprecations.fix: Keep 'new static(' (or make the class final in Phase 2); never change it to silence the sandbox PHPStan.

deprecations.why: A first-class callable is a closure; closures cannot be serialized, so a cached form (#ajax, form state cache) fatals.
deprecations.fix: Use [$this, 'method'], [static::class, 'method'], '::method' or a function-name string under #submit/#validate/#ajax/#process/...

deprecations.why: DependencySerializationTrait runs from the base-class scope: __sleep() drops private child properties and __wakeup() cannot re-initialize readonly ones.
deprecations.fix: Declare injected services protected and non-readonly in forms and plugins.

deprecations.why: #[\Override] on a method whose parent exists only in newer cores is a compile-time fatal on PHP 8.3+ with the older cores you still declare.
deprecations.fix: Do not add #[\Override] while core_version_requirement spans Drupal 10 or an older 11.x minor; add it only when every declared core has the parent method.

deprecations.why: Update path semantics matter for a port.
deprecations.fix: Keep existing hook_update_N intact; do not renumber. Add new ones only for real schema/config changes.

deprecations.why: ConfigFormBase::__construct() takes a second argument, TypedConfigManagerInterface $typedConfigManager: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.2-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass constructor that calls parent::__construct($config_factory) alone throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
deprecations.fix: Add TypedConfigManagerInterface $typed_config_manager to the subclass constructor, forward it (parent::__construct($config_factory, $typed_config_manager)) and pass $container->get('config.typed') from create().

deprecations.why: ContentTranslationController::__construct() takes a third argument, TimeInterface $time: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.3-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass passing only the manager and the entity field manager throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
deprecations.fix: Accept TimeInterface $time in the subclass constructor, forward it as the third parent argument and pass $container->get('datetime.time') from create().

deprecations.why: Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::getOriginal(): ?static (implemented by EntityBase). An entity class that already declares its own getOriginal() without a compatible return type is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+; a compatible one silently replaces core's method there.
deprecations.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().

deprecations.why: Drupal 11.2 added EntityInterface::setOriginal(?EntityInterface $original): static. An entity class declaring its own setOriginal() with another signature is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+.
deprecations.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local method. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's setOriginal().

deprecations.why: Drupal 11.3 added ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId($id): string, which core calls for its revision memory/persistent cache. A storage subclass declaring a method with that name becomes an override of core on 11.3+ (core then uses its cache ids); with an incompatible signature (no ': string', private, other parameters) it is a fatal at class load on 11.3+.
deprecations.fix: Rename the module's helper (e.g. buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()) unless overriding core's revision cache id on 11.3+ is intended; if kept, match protected function buildRevisionCacheId($id): string exactly.

deprecations.why: From 11.3 core invokes hook_entity_operation() with a second argument, CacheableMetadata $cacheability (EntityListBuilder::getOperations()); earlier cores pass only the entity. An implementation that REQUIRES the second parameter throws ArgumentCountError on every core below 11.3.
deprecations.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.

deprecations.why: From 11.3 core alters entity operations with a third argument, CacheableMetadata $cacheability; earlier cores pass only (&$operations, $entity). An implementation that REQUIRES the third parameter throws ArgumentCountError below 11.3.
deprecations.fix: Keep the two-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.

deprecations.why: ->getOriginal()/->setOriginal() on a core entity exist only from Drupal 11.2; while the declared range includes an older core the call is an 'undefined method' fatal there (unless the receiver is the module's own class).
deprecations.fix: While the floor is below 11.2: keep the ->original property, or wrap the call in DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall() (core 10.1+): backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.2', fn() => $entity->getOriginal(), fn() => $entity->original). Raise the floor to ^11.2 to use it directly.

deprecations.why: user_load_by_name()/user_load_by_mail() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core (a SOFT deprecation).
deprecations.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: $users = \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('user')->loadByProperties(['name' => $name]) (or ['mail' => $mail]); $account = $users ? reset($users) : FALSE; - works on Drupal 10 and 11.

deprecations.why: text_summary() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). Its replacement, the TextSummary service, exists only from Drupal 11.4.
deprecations.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed while the core floor is below 11.4: DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.4.0', fn() => \Drupal::service(TextSummary::class)->generate($text, $format, $size), fn() => text_summary($text, $format, $size)) - a bare TextSummary call fatals on older cores. generate() needs an int size: pass the text.settings default_summary_length when the original passed NULL.

deprecations.why: check_markup() is deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 (soft: it still works on every Drupal 11 and 12 core). There is no direct replacement.
deprecations.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: return a render array ['#type' => 'processed_text', '#text' => $text, '#format' => $format_id] instead of flattened markup (works on Drupal 10 and 11, and keeps the cacheability metadata); the call site changes from a string to a render array.

deprecations.why: user_cookie_save()/user_cookie_delete() are deprecated in drupal:11.4.0 and removed from drupal:13.0.0 with no replacement (soft: they still work on every Drupal 11 and 12 core).
deprecations.fix: Handled per DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS. When fixed: inline core's own body, e.g. setrawcookie('Drupal.visitor.' . $field, rawurlencode($value), \Drupal::time()->getRequestTime() + 31536000, '/') - works on every core.

deprecations.why: user_roles() and user_role_names() were deprecated in drupal:10.2.0 and REMOVED in drupal:11.0.0: a call is an undefined-function fatal on every Drupal 11 core (a HARD deprecation, always fixed in Phase 1).
deprecations.fix: Use \Drupal\user\Entity\Role::loadMultiple() (available on Drupal 10) and filter inline: user_roles(TRUE) excluded the anonymous role (RoleInterface::ANONYMOUS_ID); user_role_names() mapped the roles to $role->label().

_signature_changes_comment: Catalog of Drupal 10 -> 11 BREAKING SIGNATURE changes, consumed by scripts/analysis/scan-signature-changes.sh (and the override-attribute check of check-port-safety.sh). Unlike 'deprecations' (ERE explainers matched against analyzer output), each entry is a structured detector run against the subject's SOURCE. Schema: id (the [signature:<id>] tag); kind: constructor-arity (a direct subclass of 'target' whose own __construct passes fewer than 'min_args' arguments to parent::__construct), method-signature (a class whose ancestry includes 'target' declares 'method': incompatible with 'signature' = fatal at class load on cores >= 'since'; compatible = it silently becomes an override of core there), hook-params (an implementation of hook 'target' — function <extension>_<hook>() or a #[Hook] method — that REQUIRES more than 'params_before' parameters, which cores < 'since' never pass), symbol-min-core (an ERE 'pattern' for an API that exists only from 'since', unless a 'guard' ERE appears within the 5 lines before); since (first core MAJOR.MINOR with the change); required_in (when an optional addition became mandatory); known_descendants (verified core classes whose ancestry includes 'target', used only when no Drupal root is available to read it); symbol (keys the deterministic change-records search URL — never a node id); why / fix / d10_compat (what to do while ^10 is still declared); verified (the core source the fact was checked against). RULE: only add an entry after verifying it against core source on every branch it names (git.drupalcode.org or a composer-installed core) — never from memory.

signature_changes.why: ConfigFormBase::__construct() takes a second argument, TypedConfigManagerInterface $typedConfigManager: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.2-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass constructor that calls parent::__construct($config_factory) alone throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
signature_changes.fix: Add TypedConfigManagerInterface $typed_config_manager to the subclass constructor, forward it (parent::__construct($config_factory, $typed_config_manager)) and pass $container->get('config.typed') from create().
signature_changes.d10_compat: Safe for ^10 || ^11: 10.2+ accepts the argument, and PHP ignores an extra argument on older 10.x/9.x cores.
signature_changes.verified: core/lib/Drupal/Core/Form/ConfigFormBase.php: 10.2.x-10.6.x `protected $typedConfigManager = NULL` (+ deprecation when not a TypedConfigManagerInterface); 11.0.x-11.x `protected TypedConfigManagerInterface $typedConfigManager` (required).

signature_changes.why: ContentTranslationController::__construct() takes a third argument, TimeInterface $time: optional (omitting it deprecated) in 10.3-10.x, REQUIRED from 11.0. A subclass passing only the manager and the entity field manager throws ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.
signature_changes.fix: Accept TimeInterface $time in the subclass constructor, forward it as the third parent argument and pass $container->get('datetime.time') from create().
signature_changes.d10_compat: Safe for ^10 || ^11: 10.3+ accepts the argument, and PHP ignores an extra argument on older cores.

An entity class that already declares its own getOriginal() without a compatible return type is a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' on 11.2+; a compatible one silently replaces core's method there.
signature_changes.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().
signature_changes.d10_compat: Core's getOriginal() does not exist below 11.2: code kept for ^10 must not call it on core entities (use the deprecated ->original property, or DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall()).
signature_changes.verified: core/lib/Drupal/Core/Entity/EntityInterface.php: absent in 10.6.x and 11.1.x; `public function getOriginal(): ?static;` in 11.2.x, 11.3.x, 11.x (EntityBase implements it).

signature_changes.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local method. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's setOriginal().
signature_changes.d10_compat: Core's setOriginal() does not exist below 11.2.
signature_changes.verified: core/lib/Drupal/Core/Entity/EntityInterface.php: absent in 10.6.x and 11.1.x; `public function setOriginal(?EntityInterface $original): static;` in 11.2.x, 11.3.x, 11.x.

signature_changes.why: Drupal 11.3 added ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId($id): string, which core calls for its revision memory/persistent cache. A storage subclass declaring a method with that name becomes an override of core on 11.3+ (core then uses its cache ids); with an incompatible signature (no ': string', private, other parameters) it is a fatal at class load on 11.3+.
signature_changes.fix: Rename the module's helper (e.g. buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()) unless overriding core's revision cache id on 11.3+ is intended; if kept, match protected function buildRevisionCacheId($id): string exactly.
signature_changes.d10_compat: Never add #[\Override] to it while the core floor is below 11.3: the parent method does not exist there and PHP 8.3+ fatals at compile time.

An implementation that REQUIRES the second parameter throws ArgumentCountError on every core below 11.3.
signature_changes.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
signature_changes.d10_compat: An optional second parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.

Raise the floor to ^11.2 to use it directly.

_lifecycle_comment: Lifecycle catalog for scripts/analysis/classify-deprecations.sh (DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS). A deprecation is HARD when it is removed in a Drupal major <= the target major (a Drupal 11 port must fix it) and SOFT when it is removed in a later major (it still works on every core of the target major). The classifier reads deprecated-in/removed-in from the analyzer message itself; this catalog adds what the message cannot carry: the replacement, the first core that has it (replacement_since, MAJOR.MINOR; compared with the declared core floor to decide between a direct fix and a DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall guard), the effort (S/M/L) and the removal facts for a symbol that is already gone (PHPStan then says 'Function X not found.', with no versions). Schema: symbol (function name, or Class::method), kind, deprecated_in, removed_in, replacement, replacement_since (null = no replacement on any core), effort, verified (the core source checked). RULE: only add an entry after verifying it against core source on every branch it names - never from memory.
